title: Wither Skull Barter
description: Adds Wither Skeleton Skull to a Piglin Barter pool
body:
Adds **Wither Skeleton Skull** to a Piglin Bartering loot table.

The default weight is **5**, which makes a drop chance of **~1.07%**, or **5/469**, or as rare as **Enchanted Book with Soul Speed** barter drop from vanilla loot table.

For the reference use Minecraft Wiki page on **[Bartering](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Bartering#Items_bartered)**.
